# MANIFEST: Raven `core` module, C -> Zig

Targets: one `src/core/<file>.zig` per `src/core/<file>.c`, exporting exactly the non-static functions and globals
listed below (the check is `./check_unit.sh src/core/<file>.zig [target]`). Header units already written (all pass
`check_unit.sh`, for the host, `x86_64-linux-gnu` and `x86_64-windows-gnu`; their layout is verified against the C
compiler by `check.sh` step 3b, generated by `tools/gen_core_layout.py`):

| C header | header unit | contents |
|---|---|---|
| core/base.h | `base_h.zig` (done earlier) | math, geometry, colors, arena, text, memory/string/UTF-8/error prototypes |
| core/context.h | `context_h.zig` | `rvn_context_t`, `rvn_theme_t`, style/task/timer/action types, `pub extern var g_rvn`, `RVN_THEME_COLOR/METRIC`, private context function prototypes |
| core/accessibility.h | `accessibility_h.zig` | `rvn_a11y_node_t`, state flags, event/action constants, prototypes |
| core/thread.h | `thread_h.zig` | mutex/rwlock/cond/thread types (pthread types of the OS; `?*anyopaque` on Windows), atomics as inline fns, prototypes |
| core/fs.h | `fs_h.zig` | `rvn_dir_entry_t`, `rvn_place_t`, `RVN_PATH_SEPARATOR`, `rvn_path_is_separator`, prototypes |
| core/handle.h | `handle_h.zig` | handle type consts, `rvn_handle_*` inline fns, `rvn_pool_t`, prototypes |
| core/lfmap.h | `lfmap_h.zig` | `rvn_lfmap_slot_t`, `rvn_lfmap_table_t`, `rvn_lfmap_t`, prototypes |
| core/jobs.h | `jobs_h.zig` | `rvn_job_group_t`, callback types, prototypes |
| core/heap.h | `heap_h.zig` | prototypes (`RMemoryStats` from raven) |
| core/fs_watch.h | `fs_watch_h.zig` | callback type, prototypes |

Extern declarations of other modules' private functions: `externs.zig` (see its header comment). Public API (`R...`)
is `@import("raven")`. libc: `../sys/libc.zig`.

Notes for translators
- Zig signature column: where a `pub extern fn` for the symbol already exists (raven.zig, a header unit) the line is
  copied from it with `pub extern` replaced by `export`; otherwise it is derived from the C signature (internal
  functions with no header in core). `rvn_widget_t*` / `rvn_window_t*` are `?*anyopaque` until widget_h.zig exists
  (they are defined in the widget module); `rvn_platform_t*` is `?*const anyopaque` in `g_rvn.platform`.
- The Zig file must import its own header unit's declarations but must not re-export them: define the function with
  `export fn`, and call the others through the header unit (the extern and the export may coexist).
- Variadic definitions (`rvn_error` in error.c, `rvn_text_printf` in memory.c): PORTING.md 4.11, written
  `export fn f(..., format: [*c]const u8, ...) callconv(.c) void` with `@cVaStart()`; `std.builtin.VaList` is disabled
  for `x86_64-windows` (and `aarch64-linux`), so `error.zig` / `memory.zig` are checked for the host and `x86_64-linux-gnu` only.
- In the Zig column, bare `rvn_*_t` names are the types of the header units (`a11y.`, `fs.`, `thread.`, `handle.`, `lfmap.`,
  `jobs.`, `ctx.`, `base.` aliases of your imports); `raven.` is `@import("raven")`.
- `rvn_a11y_*`, `rvn_locale_*` and `rvn_tasks_run` are exported by core but declared in headers of other modules, so
  their `pub extern fn` are in `externs.zig` (second half).
- `thread_posix.c` and `thread_win32.c` define the same symbols (only one is in a build): two Zig files
  `thread_posix.zig` and `thread_win32.zig`, check the first on host/linux, the second with `x86_64-windows-gnu`.
  The atomics of thread.h are inline functions in `thread_h.zig` (stdatomic branch, seq_cst); the MSVC branch is not translated.
- Non-header C macros `RVN_API_GUARD(result)` / `RVN_API_GUARD_VOID()` (context.h) use `__func__`: write
  `if (ctx.rvn_api_check("Rname") == 0) return result;` with the literal function name.
- `rvn_tasks_run` (context.c) is non-static and declared only by a local prototype at the top of context.c.
- `accessibility.c` reads `rvn_widget_t` fields: it needs `widget/widget_h.zig` (struct `rvn_widget_t`, owned by the
  widget module). If it does not exist when you get there, stop and report.
- Checks run: all header units OK on host / linux / windows; `check.sh` (2 ported files): PASS, step 3b "208 values".

## Layout check removed (2026-11-13)

The C-vs-Zig layout check of this module's private types (layout/*_layout.c and its Zig side) was removed: every C file of
the library is translated, so no C code compiles the private headers any more and the header units are the only definition
of these types. `check.sh` step 3 still compares the public types (include/raven) with the C compiler, and step 3b the
system types (pthread, timespec, pollfd, dirent) the Zig code takes from std.c (layout/system_layout.c).
